change: Extend bounded default-build float SIMD to arrays with whole-loop bounds guards. Require a valid vector plan; retain existing overlap checks, scalar bounds-failure fallback and tails.
coverage: float32 and float64 comprehension and fused expression IR contains vector loads/stores
native AVX2 selection and forced SSE2; lengths 0 through 19
shared input arrays; short second input still reports bounds failure
existing pointer overlap, ordered reduction, matrix and parallel cases
limits: Native x86-64 default optimization, excluding debug/watch/REPL. Short eligible functions only; release optimizer unchanged.
No general C performance parity claim; these kernels allocate results and use each language's allocator.
Release controls varied 4–9% on the large memory workload and about 1–2% on the small workload. No release speedup claim.
Compile CPU and other applications remain near baseline; wall timings were noisy, especially the small tour compilation.
Three software-render samples are validation, not evidence of a rendering speedup. PNG hashes match for both games.
validation: Independent C bootstrap: 519 numeric, comprehension and parallel checks passed in 15.90s. Earlier previous-core checks: 517 passed in 21.29s plus the two new SIMD tests passed in 3.46s. Ruff and git diff --check passed.
